[P2] Return the public API changes to design review

Rules 3 and 7 require an alternatives comparison and an explicit record of additional decisions. The description inventories the chosen removals but omits that comparison and the decision to drop `threshold=None`. Previously, explicitly passing `None` selected 0.5; now `check` and `label` call the model before failing the comparison, potentially repeating requests under default retries. Experimental status does not waive these rules. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and agree the API contract, alternatives, and breaking-edge decisions.
